text:
Zara: Quick sanity check — nightly preview showed a sudden 0.9% revenue drop for the planned price-sheet experiment. looks tied to grandfathering flags.
Ben: Is this the vendor upload we accepted this morning?
Zara: Yes. vendor sent JSON payload instead of CSV; our parser defaulted missing keys to false which flipped legacy_credit off for ~1.2k accounts.
Imani: Sample ids: acct-334, acct-778, acct-992.
Zara: Gateway preview snippet: `acct-334 preview_rate=0.012 legacy_credit=true`
Zara: Ingest log: `parsed.legacy_credit=false source=vendor-json`
Carlos: Parser bug: when payload uses camelCase `legacyCredit` we fall back to legacy_credit=false. should normalize keys.
Imani: Immediate mitigation: suspend new cohort enrollments and disable preview-email job. we should not notify customers yet.
Zara: Agreed. pausing enrollments now (job: enrollments-2024-04-10).
Carlos: I'll push a tiny normalization patch that accepts both `legacyCredit` and `legacy_credit` and treats missing/empty as false. adding a schema check that errors on unknown types.
billing-bot: Incident created: FIN-2333 - "ratecard ingest: legacyCredit key mismatch" assigned to Carlos (P2). https://redwood.example/incidents/FIN-2333
Ben: Finance: after patch, run backfill to recompute previews and produce per-account delta. thresholds: >1% hold canary; 0.25-1% allow 25% conservative enroll; <0.25% proceed.
Imani: Legal/CS: hold until we confirm previews weren't sent externally. I'll scan outbound email logs.
Zara: Found ~12 preview emails to internal stakeholders only. no customer-facing sends.
Carlos: Patch deployed to staging. ingest test with vendor JSON shows correct flags. backfill queued: job-9407 (recompute previews + diffs). ETA 20m.
billing-bot: Backfill queued: job-9407.
Ben: Once backfill finishes post per-account CSV to FIN-2333 and tag finance.
Imani: After backfill: delta = 0.18% projected ARR — within threshold. product ok to proceed with 25% enrollment cap.
Zara: Re-enabled enrollments with cap, re-enabled previews for internal only. will monitor overnight.
Carlos: Adding CI check: incoming ratecard schema must include normalized keys and a checksum; vendor contract update requested.
billing-bot: FIN-2333 resolved by Carlos.
